svg.text: 5.1 V 5 A, powers the Pi only
MSI PRO MP165 E6, behind the base
Mini screen, on its angled stand
5 V rail (from the Pi, never from a GPIO pin)
Perfboard, right side of the base
Control strip, front of the base: buttons and switches
Inputs use the Pi internal pull-ups, active LOW. Kill switch: NC contacts between GPIO22 and GND; open (HIGH) means frozen. Never wire a button or switch to 5 V.
LED path: 5 V rail, resistor, LED anode, LED cathode, ULN2003 output. A GPIO HIGH turns its LED on. Measure each LED's forward voltage before soldering (green especially).
Note A: button LEDs with a built-in resistor get no external resistor. A plain LED needs 200 Ω (green) or 220 Ω (red). COORD green: 220 Ω if no 200 Ω is available.
